item.description:
Release v5.18.1

Changes since v5.18.0

  • docs: update project README
  • feat(PluginActivityBar): persist active item globally
  • feat(PluginProjectFiles): hide content header when no files are open
  • feat(ProjectsPlugin): persist opened files per project
  • fix(FactoryLumi): localize app update menu
  • fix(FactoryLumi): resolve package resource bundle
  • fix(plugin-input): hide rail and content header when active
  • fix(PluginBrewManager): decode formula and cask payloads
  • fix(PluginCodeEditor): localize plugin strings
  • fix(PluginEditorHost): localize editor states
  • refactor(EditorTextView): move resources to package root
  • refactor(FactoryLumi): move resources to package root
  • refactor(KitFileSystem): move resources to package root
  • refactor(OpenInKit): move resources to package root
  • refactor(PluginAgentRules): move resources to package root
  • refactor(PluginAgentTempStorage): move resources to package root
  • refactor(PluginAppIconDesigner): move resources to package root
  • refactor(PluginAppStorePromoDesigner): move resources to package root
  • refactor(PluginCaffeinate): move resources to package root
  • refactor(PluginChatFileAttachment): move resources to package root
